title: Complete the same-reference periodic rounded inverse service
body:
R10’s same-reference Core/halo investigation found no retained rows in the original143-row window under its sufficient halo certificate, and no wrapping numerical producer. This package supplies an explicitly paid whole-period fallback for the unchanged Reference(384,1,2,4,18,320): all385 inverse-action outputs, including genuine cross-period couplings and hole192.

The completed service quantizes the original rational coefficients once, then runs276 terms on a33-bit grid. The written error budget includes coefficient quantization, every data rounding, intermediate range and tail; the inherited analytic-reference perturbation is separately charged. An independent checker enumerates all148225 original matrix entries and applies the original rational matrix to the returned vector. The same-reference residual certificate is below5.04e-9; the combined funded allowance is below4.624e-7, less than2^-20.

The full host-array invoice records1,689,600 scalar products,211,750 component roundings, all update/accumulator arithmetic, borrowed-input lifetime, output copying, scratch initialization/cleanup and3072 resident coefficient records. The executed setup includes3457 source entries,384 weight records, four kernel values and four surviving pi-cache entries. Setup versus steady-state workspace is explicit. This is not a physical tape implementation or sparse-seam speed claim.

Validation includes the complete signed-complex trajectory, an actual dropped-wrap trajectory that fails the target, hole-output rejection, all omitted-entry checks, typed/radius/shape input controls and reuse on zero data. Normal generation passed in32.213s (setup29.712s); final optimized Git-free read-only validation passed in33.576s. Boolean receipt, missing-result and source-byte mutations each rejected in0.12–0.14s; all exported bytes were restored and compared afterward. Metadata, committed bytes, source history and official18-file export checks pass. An initial diagnostic failed during huge-Fraction text serialization after its arithmetic checks; that unsuccessful command is preserved and is not counted as a replay PASS.

The claim is a source-bound finite service plus its scoped written error contract. The source analytic estimates remain inherited. No physical supplier, local-halo improvement, full tensor/multiplier or kappa change is asserted. The next distinct obligation is an ordered physical coefficient/input delivery protocol with complete cyclic addressing and cleanup charges.

Exact source/attribution is retained in SOURCES.json and source notices: Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml, Vlado Vojdanovski, Jeremy Kothe, Cinna Davis, Mason Hale, Chafik Boukhalfa and prior contributors. Prepared for JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; new work Apache-2.0.
